data.revised_prompt:
Create a 2x2 animation sprite sheet on a solid #FF00FF magenta background. Four equal quadrants, no borders, no labels, no text. Isolated game attack FX only. Use the provided reference as visual inspiration for style only: cute Soft Candy jellyfish identity with translucent lavender jelly material, cyan glow, pink highlights, soft baby-blue rim light, glossy candy-gel look. Do NOT draw the avatar body, face, eyes, head, portrait, cards, UI, or any scene.

Subject in every quadrant: exactly two adorable gummy jellyfish tentacles extending from left to right. They must look soft, rounded, squishy, short-to-medium length, like pastel candy ribbons or jelly noodles, with rounded paddle-like tips. Add tiny bubbles, soft sparkles, and small heart-shaped glints if desired. No sharp barbs, no monster spikes, no realistic anatomy, no horror, no claws, no ropes, no snakes.

Layout/composition: each quadrant contains one frame of the animation, with generous magenta padding. The two tentacles occupy a wide horizontal band about 75% of each cell width and 30% of each cell height. Same scale and consistent visual style across all frames. Nothing crosses cell edges. No dividing lines.

Frame 1 top-left: two short curled gummy tentacles gathered on the left, cute and bouncy.
Frame 2 top-right: the two tentacles stretch forward to the right with soft elastic wobble, rounded tips leading.
Frame 3 bottom-left: the rounded tips slap on the right with a cute pastel pop, small bubbles and pink-cyan sparkles at the tips.
Frame 4 bottom-right: the tentacles recoil slightly with fading bubble trails and a soft jelly glow.

Render as clean high-resolution sprite art, glossy translucent lavender/cyan/pink candy-gel FX, cute rounded shapes, crisp alpha-like edges against pure #FF00FF background.
